Too broad; ResNet18 was stable in overall discrimination (AUC 0.916 +/- 0.045) and specificity (97.6 +/- 2.0%), but unstable specifically in fixed-threshold minority sensitivity.

scientific_justification: Patient distribution is a proven major contributor, but optimization dynamics, early stopping rules, and fixed thresholding also contribute; not proven to be the sole cause.
